rationale: At t=36h in stationary phase, I'm conserving resources. Acetate remains the primary carbon source; I supplement with amino acids for nitrogen and biosynthetic precursors (glycine, serine, alanine are abundant and easily transaminated). Bifidus fermentation produces lactate and acetate; modest CO₂ and formate reflect partial oxidation. Growth is limited by nitrogen availability and accumulated fermentation products; I estimate 0.20/h based on declining trend from earlier turns and the zero-growth signal at turn 8.
